description:
Also improves the error message when a kernel is missing.

Diff is somewhat big because I sorted lines. Let me know if you prefer to leave as it is.

With this change, we can run t5 in metal:

```
$ RUST_BACKTACE=1 cargo run --example t5 --release --features metal -- --model-id "t5-small" --prompt "translate English to German: As much as six inches of rain could fall in the New York City region through Monday morning, and officials warned of flooding along the coast." --temperature 0 --decode
    Finished release [optimized] target(s) in 0.19s
     Running `target/release/examples/t5 --model-id t5-small --prompt 'translate English to German: As much as six inches of rain could fall in the New York City region through Monday morning, and officials warned of flooding along the coast.' --temperature 0 --decode`
 Bis zu sechs Zoll Regen könnte in der Region New York bis Montag morgens fallen, und Beamte warnten vor Überschwemmungen entlang der Küste.
34 tokens generated (132.73 token/s)
```

comments.body: Two cents here, this is "strided unary", not "binary" :-)
Tried to improve more generally all these in https://github.com/huggingface/candle/pull/1491.
Ooops. Thanks! I copied the messages you proposed in your PR to avoid merge conflicts.
